verdict.rationale: A probe of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 on every one. Nothing in the pack documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The llms.txt index and per-page markdown docs are LLM-friendly documentation, not a structured API specification, so they are only adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
